title: Build Sansi App Collector - Message Collection and PDF Export Web App

requirements.text: Create a conversation input interface where users can manually add messages by entering sender name, message text, and timestamp. Allow users to create multiple conversations and switch between them.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create new conversations with a conversation name
Users can add individual messages to a conversation with sender, text, and timestamp fields
Users can view a list of all saved conversations
Users can switch between different conversations to view or edit them
All conversation data persists in the backend

requirements.text: Display conversation messages chronologically with timestamps in a chat-like interface, showing sender names and message bubbles for each entry.

quotes: Display conversation messages chronologically with timestamps

acceptanceCriteria: Messages appear in chronological order (oldest to newest)
Each message shows sender name, message text, and timestamp
Messages are styled in a chat bubble layout similar to messaging apps
The conversation view scrolls smoothly with proper spacing

requirements.text: Implement PDF export functionality that generates a well-formatted PDF document with chat-style layout, including conversation title, date range, and all messages with timestamps.

quotes: Export conversation to well-formatted PDF with chat layout

acceptanceCriteria: Users can trigger PDF export with a dedicated button
Generated PDF includes conversation name as title
PDF shows date range of the conversation
Messages in PDF maintain chronological order with sender names and timestamps
PDF layout resembles a chat interface with proper formatting
PDF can be downloaded to the user's device

requirements.text: Add a search feature that allows users to filter messages within a conversation by text content, returning matching messages highlighted in the view.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input field is prominently displayed above the message list
Search filters messages in real-time as user types
Matching text is highlighted in the message bubbles
Search is case-insensitive
Clear button resets the search filter

requirements.text: Implement date range selection for PDF export, allowing users to choose start and end dates to export only messages within that range.
acceptanceCriteria: Date range picker appears when user initiates PDF export
Users can select both start date and end date
Only messages within the selected range are included in the PDF
Date range is displayed in the exported PDF header
Default range includes all messages if no selection is made

requirements.text: Enable exporting multiple conversations into a single PDF document, with each conversation clearly separated and labeled.

quotes: Export multiple conversations into one PDF

acceptanceCriteria: Users can select multiple conversations from a checklist
Export button generates a single PDF containing all selected conversations
Each conversation section in the PDF starts with its name as a heading
Conversations are separated by clear visual dividers
PDF includes a table of contents or index of included conversations

requirements.text: Implement dark mode support with a toggle switch, applying the dark theme consistently across all pages and components using the existing OKLCH color system.
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode toggle is accessible in the app header or settings
Toggle switches between light and dark themes instantly
Dark theme uses existing dark theme CSS variables from index.css
User's theme preference persists across sessions
All UI components and text remain readable in dark mode

requirements.text: Add PIN lock functionality requiring users to set and enter a 4-6 digit PIN to access the app, with the PIN stored securely in the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: First-time users are prompted to create a PIN on initial access
Returning users must enter their PIN to unlock the app
PIN entry screen appears before main app content
PIN is stored securely in the backend (hashed)
Failed PIN attempts show error feedback
Option to reset PIN is available through Internet Identity authentication

requirements.text: Remove or replace the existing PlatformLimitations and WebAlternatives informational sections with the actual Sansi App Collector functionality, maintaining only the header, footer, and minimalist design theme.

quotes: create a responsive web app name it sansi app collector

acceptanceCriteria: PlatformLimitations component is removed from the main App
WebAlternatives component is removed from the main App
Main app layout shows conversation management interface instead
Header and Footer components remain intact
Minimalist design with white background and coral accent color is preserved

constraints: Maintain the existing minimalist design theme with white background, simple typography, and coral accent color
Preserve the Footer component with attribution link unchanged
All data must persist in the backend using Motoko
PDF generation must happen client-side in the frontend
nonGoals: Actual SMS reading or device permissions
Cloud storage integration (AWS, Google Drive, etc.)
